items.followUp: Define gravitational field strength and state its approximate value at the surface of the Moon.

rubric.why: Identifies gravitational field strength as force per unit mass.
rubric.description: Gravitational field strength is the gravitational force acting per unit mass at a point.
rubric.how: Award for a correct force-per-unit-mass definition.

rubric.why: States the approximate value of gravitational field strength on Earth with a suitable unit.
rubric.description: On Earth, gravitational field strength is approximately 9.8 N/kg (about 10 N/kg).
rubric.how: Accept 9.8 or 10 with a suitable unit, such as N/kg or m/s².

modelAnswer: Gravitational field strength is the gravitational force acting per unit mass at a point.
On Earth, its value is approximately 9.8 N/kg (about 10 N/kg).
